name: isomorphic-git-under-bare-probe
comment: isomorphic-git is pure-JS (pako/sha.js/diff3 — no native addons), so it installs from the registry and — unlike avsc — needs NO fork. The only wrinkle: its CJS/'node' build hard-requires node 'crypto'; Bare lacks it, so we use the ESM build (index.js), which falls back to pure-JS sha.js.
